author: JaTasroc
quote: Really loved the gta series growing up, I remember putting many hours into gta 1 when I was 11, this game is not the gta I remeber. Ive played ever single one & loved them, this doea not even seem like the same game. You cannot hurt certain npc's? Or steal ceratin cars? You cannot drive thru certain areas with a car? This is not gta anymore. If I wanted to play a game were Im catering to someone hand & foot I would play sims 4. I play videos games to get away from life. I dont want to play games & have to do tedious tasks to pass a main mission. Sad day for gta fans who are tricked into likeing this simply because they waited so long its they just want it to be good, also cause they paid so much. I am past the point or being able to refund this game & sad theres no physical so I cant sell it. I will not be playing this game any further. But for those that do enjoy I meant no offense. You just do you.

author: JaTasroc
quote: Such a great game, very good gameplay very well written characters, gameplay mechanics and everything are top-notch. I did not expect that from this game I had no interest in the game and played the demo and immediately bought it afterwards beat the game within 2 weeks. Nearly every second I was not at work I was playing this game I have not enjoyed a game like this in a very long time. Cannot wait for dlc

author: JaTasroc
quote:
Nothing like what I fell in love with when I was younger with the very first game was my first experience with a same-sex couple in a game and having just came out as a bi man it meant a lot to me to see that represented in a game and not be forced upon anybody even the player. Now in this game the genders and the sexualities are forced upon you  And everybody around you, companions, non players anybody who sees it and if you do not accept it you are the one in the wrong. The gameplay is not the same It lost its dark atmosphere which would made me like the game, it feels like I am playing a Fortnite expansion. You basically cannot even insult any party members or anybody in the game you have to always pick the correct option              *SPOILERS* That they want you to pick and be nice to everybody otherwise it penalizes you in the end. *END SPOILERS* The game is not even an RPG anymore it has to light RPG mechanics.

 The game forces its views and politics upon you as a player. I play video games to escape stuff like this in the real world. Certain games like metaphor refantazio have pretty much nothing but politics in the game but they go about it the right way that you should be doing it, also has good gameplay and a good story.  The game is focused on the gameplay/story and not on politics like dragonage.
